tagline: 奥林巴斯无反相机，2011 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2011年推出的无反相机。配备Micro Four Thirds System mount。快门速度1/4,000 to 60 s, up to 30 minutes bulb。

specs.传感器: Four Thirds System 17.30 × 13.00 mm Live MOS
specs.快门速度: 1/4,000 to 60 s, up to 30 minutes bulb
specs.闪光灯: No built-in flash, but has Clip-on flash included, TTL, GN 10m equivalent (ISO200 · m); hotshoe for external flash attachment
specs.曝光测光: Digital ESP metering, Centre weighted average metering, Spot metering
specs.取景器: live preview, optional electronic viewfinder VF-2; optional electronic viewfinder VF-3; optional optical viewfinder VF-1
specs.屏幕: 3" 460,000 pixel TFT LCD on screen with live preview
specs.重量: (body only) (body, battery and SD memory card)
